description: This file contains implementation of utility functions, scope management, and inlined call stack handling within the torch::jit namespace, including class definitions and method implementations related to scope and call stack management.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: Class managing scope hierarchy, including parent-child relationships, root detection, and name management.

classes.name: InlinedCallStack
classes.description: Class representing a call stack with inlining information, including function references, source ranges, and module instances.

classes.name: ModuleInstanceInfo
classes.description: Class holding information about a module instance, including its type and name.

methods.name: get_module_info
methods.description: Generates a string with module instance info, including class type and instance name.

methods.name: Scope::intrusive_from_this
methods.description: Creates an intrusive pointer from the current Scope object, incrementing reference count.

methods.name: Scope::push
methods.description: Creates a new child scope with the given name.

methods.name: Scope::parent
methods.description: Returns the parent scope, with check for existence.

methods.name: Scope::isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the scope is the root scope.

methods.name: Scope::isBlank
methods.description: Checks if the scope is the root and has a blank name.

methods.name: Scope::getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root scope by traversing parent links.

methods.name: Scope::getDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth of the scope in the hierarchy.

methods.name: Scope::namesFromRoot
methods.description: Returns the full scope name path from root, separated by a given separator.

methods.name: InlinedCallStack::intrusive_from_this
methods.description: Creates an intrusive pointer from the current InlinedCallStack object.

methods.name: InlinedCallStack::callee
methods.description: Returns the callee call stack if any.

methods.name: InlinedCallStack::source_range
methods.description: Returns the source range associated with this call stack.

methods.name: InlinedCallStack::function
methods.description: Returns the function pointer associated with this call stack.

methods.name: InlinedCallStack::function_name
methods.description: Returns the function name as a string reference.

methods.name: InlinedCallStack::vec
methods.description: Returns a vector of call stack entries representing the call chain.

methods.name: ModuleInstanceInfo::ModuleInstanceInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing module type and instance name.
